## Working session summary

Implemented and finalized issue 63 in [PR #64](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/pull/64).

Key fixes:

- Release automation now updates and stages `Cargo.lock` with `Cargo.toml`.
- Cargo CI, package, and Docker commands use `--locked`.
- Added regression and release-script unit tests.
- CI warnings now fail closed, including Rust documentation and dependency audits.
- Updated deprecated GitHub Actions/Node runtimes.
- Fixed existing rustdoc warnings and refreshed affected dependencies.

The root cause was an incomplete automated version commit combined with unlocked Cargo commands silently repairing the lockfile, allowing false-positive CI results.

All local checks passed, including tests, Clippy, formatting, rustdoc, audits, packaging, and Docker builds. Final-head [CI run 31268629785](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/actions/runs/31268629785) passed on commit `d335a65`, including Linux, macOS, Windows, package, audit, and Docker jobs.

The complete timeline, requirements, root-cause analysis, online research, raw CI logs, and solution alternatives are archived in [dev/log/issues/63/pulls/64](<workspace>/dev/log/issues/63/pulls/64/README.md).

The PR is ready, mergeable, synchronized with `main`, and the working tree is clean.
